Root Six Player: bundled dependency notices

This launcher includes the unmodified BepInEx Unity IL2CPP Windows x64 loader
distribution 6.0.0-be.788, commit 5b766a3b7f6c164d4798924a93f3acf4db769d06.
The same Windows loader is used with Steam Proton on Linux. Root game files,
Steam, Proton, and generated game bindings are not distributed in the launcher.

The startup window uses golang.org/x/exp/shiny, x/image, x/mobile, x/sys,
x/text, and github.com/jezek/xgb under their BSD licenses. The Go Regular
fallback font is copyright Bigelow & Holmes and uses a BSD license. Their
notices follow below. Root's font and Steam artwork are read from the player's
local installation and are not included in this distribution.

Linux AppImages use the unmodified AppImage type-2 runtime release 20251108,
commit dd6cebedcbddde9c82f89b011e8e1d40b6e43868. Its MIT license and linked
library notices follow below. The runtime and libfuse 3.15.0 sources, including
the upstream libfuse patch and build instructions, are included in
dependency-sources.zip. These can be used to rebuild and replace the runtime
with appimagetool's --runtime-file option. Packaging follows Compositor's
pinned appimagetool 1.9.1 and runtime versions.

Loader artifact:
https://builds.bepinex.dev/projects/bepinex_be/788/BepInEx-Unity.IL2CPP-win-x64-6.0.0-be.788%2B5b766a3.zip
SHA-256: f4cc496bd098a0df4164b81e3737297707f13a47c2478dba2f60eefab784817a

Components and upstream source versions

BepInEx 6.0.0-be.788: LGPL-2.1-only.
https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/tree/5b766a3b7f6c164d4798924a93f3acf4db769d06
Il2CppInterop 1.5.3 (Common, Generator, Runtime, HarmonySupport): LGPL-3.0-only.
https://github.com/BepInEx/Il2CppInterop/tree/dbda1cb353b0f4253345dc45136d170b9e50a5a0
UnityDoorstop 4.5.0: LGPL-2.1.
https://github.com/NeighTools/UnityDoorstop/tree/33dab9a6733862eb81869ff08431d9478b28784b

Complete upstream source archives for these three libraries accompany this
launcher in dependency-sources.zip, available through --licenses extraction.
The archive includes an index of immutable source URLs and SHA-256 checksums.
Their upstream build scripts and instructions are included in those archives.
No changes have been made to these libraries. Their license rights, including
modification and reverse engineering for debugging such modifications, remain
in effect. These licenses apply to the respective components, not to Root.

    toolchain. Go toolchain version is recorded in the built binary.

Versions above are grounded in the loader's pinned source project references,
its .doorstop_version and dotnet/.version files, NuGet package metadata, and
the bundled Cpp2IL and Disarm assembly informational versions. The immutable
license text origins and hashes are recorded in license-sources.json.

Unity base assemblies

UnityEngine base assemblies, version 2022.3.62, are bundled unchanged from the
library archive used by BepInEx for interop generation:
https://unity.bepinex.dev/libraries/2022.3.62.zip
SHA-256: 575e7d600f69de8200ccf4db700b3ae6252366c22e8c3434c860e428974518d1
Copyright Unity Technologies and respective contributors.

This archive has no accompanying license file. Its contents are not covered
by Root Six Player's license or by BepInEx's LGPL license. This notice does
not assert a separate redistribution grant for Unity's assemblies. Applicable
Unity terms remain applicable: https://unity.com/legal/terms-of-service/software
These are base engine assemblies, not copied Root assemblies or generated
game bindings. Root itself must be installed separately through Steam.

Full component license texts follow in this file. The individual source URLs
are included next to each text. Upstream license texts are preserved verbatim.
